def transform(grid):
    """Extend the shorter of the first rows of the two non-background bands."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [any(v != bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    bands = []
    i = 0
    while i < h:
        if not active[i]:
            i += 1
            continue
        start = i
        while i < h and active[i]:
            i += 1
        bands.append(start)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(bands) >= 2:
        a, b = bands[:2]
        enda = max((j for j, v in enumerate(grid[a]) if v != bg), default=-1)
        endb = max((j for j, v in enumerate(grid[b]) if v != bg), default=-1)
        row, end = (a, enda) if enda < endb else (b, endb)
        for j in range(end + 1, w):
            out[row][j] = 1
    return out
PY
